registered.content: Float32Array-backed storage plus an optional ‘out’ parameter gives you zero-copy GPU uploads and allocation-free hot loops in <500 lines of code—something most engines need thousands of lines to achieve.
Float32Array storage + single mutable-in-place convention gives almost all the PlayCanvas perf win in <150 lines; the remaining 300 lines are ergonomic sugar you can live without.

PlayCanvas’s Entity/Component layer is only ~700 lines and already gives us GUIDs, runtime add/remov

registered.content: PlayCanvas’s Entity/Component/GraphNode trio achieves the smallest possible ECS that is still scene-graph aware and production proven; copying its flat component storage and lifecycle hooks gives us a zero-cost, cache-friendly foundation we can ship today.
700-line Entity/GraphNode/Component triplet is self-contained; the rest of PlayCanvas is optional baggage we can simply leave behind.
